0.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_000
0.description: Good day to you, <hex:020816E905FF086D79206C616479FF09676F6F642073697203>. My name is Hawu Bajihri, and it is both my honor and privilege to assist happily bonded couples who wish to celebrate their anniversary and renew their vows.
0.translation_description: Buongiorno, <hex:020825E905FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F7261FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F726503>. Mi chiamo Hawu Bajihri e per me è un onore assistere con piacere le coppie unite dal Legame Eterno che desiderano festeggiare il loro anniversario e rinnovare i voti.

1.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_001
1.description: I very much look forward to the day you have need of my services.
1.translation_description: Non vedo l’ora di poterti assistere quando ne avrai bisogno.

2.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_010
2.description: Good day to you, <hex:020816E905FF086D79206C616479FF09676F6F642073697203>. I do hope you and your beloved have been well.
2.translation_description: Buongiorno, <hex:020825E905FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F7261FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F726503>. Spero che tu e la persona amata stiate bene.

3.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_011
3.description: As you may know, it is my duty to oversee the renewal of vows between bonded couples who have registered their anniversary with the Sanctum of the Twelve. Should you have need of my services, pray do not hesitate to ask.
3.translation_description: Come forse sai, spetta a me occuparmi del rinnovo dei voti delle coppie che hanno registrato il proprio anniversario al Santuario dei Dodici. Se hai bisogno del mio aiuto, non esitare a chiedermelo.

4.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_012
4.description: To register your anniversary, you and your partner must be in a party together with your eternity rings in your inventory.
4.translation_description: Per registrare l’anniversario, tu e il tuo partner dovete far parte dello stesso gruppo e avere entrambi l’anello dell’Eternità nell’inventario.

7.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_A1_000_001
7.description: Inquire about anniversaries at the Sanctum.
7.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sugli anniversari al Santuario.

9.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_Q2_000_000
9.description: Register your anniversary with the Sanctum of the Twelve?
9.translation_description: Vuoi registrare il vostro anniversario presso il Santuario dei Dodici?

10.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_020
10.description: Very well. If you should change your mind you need but ask.
10.translation_description: Molto bene. Se cambi idea, ti basterà chiedermelo.

12.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_022
12.description: I believe I speak for all here at the Sanctum when I say we look forward to your return.
12.translation_description: Credo di parlare a nome di tutti noi del Santuario quando dico che aspettiamo con piacere il tuo ritorno.

13.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_023
13.description: The anniversary date engraved on your eternity ring has been registered with the Sanctum of the Twelve.
13.translation_description: La data dell’anniversario incisa sul tuo anello dell’Eternità è stata registrata presso il Santuario dei Dodici.

14.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_024
14.description: When the day of your anniversary arrives, you will receive a notification the next time you enter the East Shroud or any town.
14.translation_description: Il giorno del tuo anniversario riceverai una notifica la prossima volta che entrerai nel Velo Orientale o in una città qualsiasi.

15.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_025
15.description: You may then speak with Hawu Bajihri to undertake the quest “The Ties that Bind,” beginning from the ceremony planning stage of the quest, and renew your vows in the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.
15.translation_description: Potrai parlare con Hawu Bajihri per iniziare la missione «I legami che uniscono» dalla fase di pianificazione della cerimonia e rinnovare i voti durante la Cerimonia del Legame Eterno.

16.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_030
16.description: Be it your first or fiftieth, the anniversary of an eternal bond is an important malmstone.
16.translation_description: Che sia il primo o il cinquantesimo anniversario del vostro Legame Eterno, è una tappa importante.

17.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_031
17.description: And to celebrate such a momentous occasion, we believe each and every blessed couple that walks the Sanctum's halls deserves the opportunity to relive the joyous day they pledged their devotion to one another.
17.translation_description: Per celebrare un’occasione così speciale, crediamo che ogni coppia benedetta che varca le soglie del Santuario meriti di rivivere il giorno felice in cui si è promessa amore eterno.

18.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_032
18.description: Of course, this is not to say your ceremony should be <hex:021A020203>exactly<hex:021A020103> as it was before. All of our resources will be at your disposal, that you may have a ceremony as modest or extravagant as you desire.
18.translation_description: Naturalmente, questo non significa che la vostra cerimonia debba essere <hex:021A020203>esattamente<hex:021A020103> come quella precedente. Avrete a disposizione tutte le nostre risorse, per renderla sobria o sfarzosa quanto desiderate.

19.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_033
19.description: To register your anniversary, you and your partner must be in a party together with your eternity rings in your inventory.
19.translation_description: Per registrare l’anniversario, tu e il tuo partner dovete far parte dello stesso gruppo e avere entrambi l’anello dell’Eternità nell’inventario.

20.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_034
20.description: Should you choose to register, you will have the option to celebrate your anniversary on or after the date engraved on your eternity ring.
20.translation_description: Se decidi di registrarlo, potrai festeggiare il tuo anniversario dal giorno inciso sul tuo anello dell’Eternità in poi.

22.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_041
22.description: Good day to you, <hex:020816E905FF086D79206C616479FF09676F6F642073697203>. I do hope you and your beloved have been well. Have you need of my services?
22.translation_description: Buongiorno, <hex:020825E905FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F7261FF1067656E74696C65207369676E6F726503>. Spero che tu e la persona amata stiate bene. Hai bisogno del mio aiuto?

24.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_A3_000_000
24.description: I would like to confirm the date of my anniversary.
24.translation_description: Vorrei confermare la data del mio anniversario.

25.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_A3_000_001
25.description: I wish to cancel my registration with the Sanctum.
25.translation_description: Vorrei annullare la registrazione del mio anniversario al Santuario.

26.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_A3_000_002
26.description: I wish to renew my vows.

29.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_051
29.description: Please note the option to celebrate your anniversary is only available on or after the date engraved on your eternity ring.
29.translation_description: Ricorda: potrai festeggiare il tuo anniversario solo dal giorno inciso sul tuo anello dell’Eternità in poi.

30.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_052
30.description: You would no longer be allowed to celebrate your anniversary here at the Sanctum of the Twelve. Are you quite certain this is what you want?
30.translation_description: Non potrai più festeggiare il tuo anniversario al Santuario dei Dodici. Vuoi davvero procedere?

31.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_053
31.description: Please note you can speak with Hawu Bajihri at any time to re-register your anniversary with the Sanctum of the Twelve.
31.translation_description: Puoi parlare con Hawu Bajihri in qualsiasi momento per registrare di nuovo il tuo anniversario presso il Santuario dei Dodici.

32.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_Q4_000_000
32.translation_description: Vuoi annullare la registrazione del tuo anniversario?

33.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_054
33.description: Very well. I shall have you and your beloved's names removed from our records. Should you have a change of heart, please do not hesitate to come and speak with me.
33.translation_description: Molto bene. Rimuoverò i tuoi nomi e quelli del tuo partner dai nostri registri. Se cambi idea, non esitare a parlarmi.

34.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_060
34.description: Though I do admire your enthusiasm, our records show your anniversary has not yet come to pass. I am afraid you will have to wait a while longer.
34.translation_description: Ammiro il tuo entusiasmo, ma dai nostri registri risulta che la data del vostro anniversario non è ancora arrivata. Temo che dovrai aspettare ancora un po’.

35.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_061
35.description: My, how time flies. On behalf of all here at the Sanctum of the Twelve, let me be the first to offer you and your partner congratulations.
35.translation_description: Come vola il tempo! A nome di tutti noi del Santuario, voglio fare le mie congratulazioni a te e al tuo partner prima di chiunque altro.

36.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_062
36.description: You need but say the word and we will begin preparations for your ceremony at once.
36.translation_description: Basta che tu me lo dica e inizieremo subito a preparare la cerimonia.

37.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_Q5_000_000
37.description: To renew your vows, you must undertake the quest “The Ties that Bind,” starting from the ceremony planning stage of the quest.<hex:02100103>Proceed?
37.translation_description: Per rinnovare i voti, dovrete intraprendere la missione «I legami che uniscono» dalla fase di pianificazione della cerimonia.<hex:02100103>Procedere?

38.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_063
38.description: Understood. There is no need to rush, after all.

39.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_064
39.description: I shall have our acolytes make ready, then.
39.translation_description: Chiederò ai nostri accoliti di prepararsi.

40.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_065
40.description: May the Twelve never let the memory of this blessed day fade from your hearts.
40.translation_description: Che i Dodici conservino nei vostri cuori il ricordo di questo giorno benedetto.

41.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_066
41.translation_description: Hai ricevuto un bracciale della promessa.

42.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_SYSTEM_000_067
42.description: You may now proceed with the quest “The Ties that Bind,” starting from the ceremony planning stage.
42.translation_description: Ora puoi intraprendere la missione «I legami che uniscono» dalla fase di pianificazione della cerimonia.

43.name: TEXT_CTSETCREWEDDING_00531_HAWUBAJIHRI_000_069
43.description: Do not let me keep you waiting. Your ceremony awaits!
43.translation_description: Non ti faccio attendere oltre: la cerimonia ti aspetta!
